sql: SELECT account_hash, COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id) AS vendor_count, concat_ws(',', sort_array(collect_set(vendor_id))) AS vendor_ids, concat_ws(',', sort_array(collect_set(CAST(status AS STRING)))) AS statuses FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account GROUP BY account_hash HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id) > 1 LIMIT 50
